items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: I knew Louis all my life. ... See, I never did play with him.

ctx.x: Because a tubo player I know on the west coast told me, he says that's not on the rhythm.

Well I remember when Louis Armstrong was here, he was playing in the Tuxedo Brass Band at that time. And they used to play Panama. And he used to make that high note. And they felt like Louis Armstrong was true, I knew Louis all my life. Practically all my life. See, but I never did play with him. See, I never had the opportunity to play with him because I wasn't just up to it. I was just crawling in the manner of speaking.
What year did you start playing an instrument?
